description.text: Compulsory Courses Economics★, Introduction of Management★, Principle of Accounting★, Monetary Banking★, International Economics★, International Finance★, Finance★, Economic Law, Insurance★, International Trade★, International Trade Practice★,International Marketing★, International Commercial Law★, Principle of Statistics★, English Intensive Reading, English Extensive Reading, Listening English, Oral English, Writing English, Computer Principle, Calculus, Probability Theory, Linear Algebra, etc. Optional Courses International Trade Geography, Foreign Trade Accounting★, Foreign Trade English Reading★, Multicultural Exchange, Cross-cultural Communication, Network Application Basis, Financial Management★, The Second Foreign Language, International Clearing★, International Tax★, Investment★, International Business Negotiation★, E-commerce★, International Technologic Trade★, International Transportation and Insurance★, International Service Trade★, Customs Practice★, Foreign Trade Manufacturing Orders★, etc. Courses marked with “★” will be taught in English or bilingual language.

duration.text: The International Economics and Trade at Beijing Language and Culture University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3222 USD/per year ￥ 23200 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Certificate of HSK For applicants of Chinese Language major and Chinese Language and Culture major:Level 3 or above. For those applying to take classes with Chinese students: HSK Level 6 or above 2. Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 3. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 4. Certificate/diploma of highest education Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. 5. Academic transcript of highest education Original transcript of academic record. 6. Valid identity document of the applicant's emergency contact person A photocopy of the ID of the emergency contact (can be a license, official ID of Chinese citizen or foreigner). 7. Letter of recommendation Reference letter from applicants' former teacher.

requirements.text: Applicant should be a senior high school graduate or with equivalent schooling in the age bracket of 18-50,with an HSK certificate (level 6 or above). (Classes will be taken together with Chinese students.)
